conclusion: The reviewed 2026-10-25 organic support source separates same-plane body/interface footprints independently of top Z gap and filament mergeability. Structural trunk contours remain closed; bottom transitions and local native bridge bracing provide bearing without mirroring or reconstructing interface patterns. The matching Release verification passes 30 organic/tree-bridge cases with 2730 assertions, including 16 curved-floor combinations, plus 119 clearance/interface assertions. Two unmodified test2 exports contain identical 6279-command sequences and 56 planes. Original model geometry, support contours, 87 interface paths and six Brim paths are retained within output precision; support paths change from 65 to 71 through six local bridges at Z=4.4 mm. Bottom emitted geometry is 0.170003 mm above the model surface and the top gap is 0.17 mm. The earlier NAS-model 302-to-280 interface and 19560-wall counts remain historical. No physical print or arbitrary-model guarantee is claimed.
scope: Current organic support role boundaries and source-bound Release acceptance as of 2026-10-25; Contact gaps are computed from printed model surfaces and extrusion height. No physical print trial or arbitrary-model performance guarantee is established.
